purpose: Select a Java reverse-call analysis starting point across Quarkus and Spring Boot without promoting unsupported framework or dynamic edges to definite paths.

criteria.title: Build and context fidelity
criteria.requirement: The candidate consumes the selected Quarkus or Spring Boot fixture with its Maven production/test profile, source roots, generated roots, dependency classpath, framework identity, and target symbols recorded.
criteria.passEvidence: A reproducible run completes for both framework inputs and records provider, Java, Maven, dependency, framework, profile, source, and generated-source fingerprints.

criteria.title: Direct reverse calls
criteria.requirement: The candidate finds a caller of an affected Java method and returns stable symbol identity plus source location.
criteria.passEvidence: The candidate finds ServerUserAuthService#handleUserAuthRequestMessage as a caller of UserAuthPublicKey#doAuth.

criteria.title: Dispatch and callbacks
criteria.requirement: The candidate represents interface/virtual dispatch, lambdas, method references, and callback registration without overstating runtime certainty.
criteria.passEvidence: Expected edges are found and classified as definite or possible with the dispatch basis recorded.

criteria.title: Framework wiring
criteria.requirement: The candidate either resolves CDI/Quarkus or Spring injection and generated proxy identity or explicitly reports the relationship as possible/unresolved with the missing context.
criteria.passEvidence: The FrameworkModel and AnalysisContext link an injection point to one selected bean, bound candidates, or an explicit unresolved abstention.

criteria.title: Metadata and generated inputs
criteria.requirement: The candidate handles ServiceLoader metadata, generated source, and build-profile differences as explicit analysis inputs.
criteria.passEvidence: The provider result changes predictably when metadata, generated sources, or the selected profile changes.

criteria.title: Dynamic-feature safety
criteria.requirement: Reflection and dynamic proxies never become definite edges without constrained, source-backed or configuration-backed evidence.
criteria.passEvidence: Known constant targets may be possible; unconstrained Class.forName, Method.invoke, and Proxy targets remain unknown/unresolved.

criteria.title: SemanticCallFacts output
criteria.requirement: The candidate output can be normalized into caller, callee, relationship type, certainty, evidence, and limitation fields.
criteria.passEvidence: The normalized output preserves definite, possible, and unresolved relationships without losing source evidence.

criteria.title: Provenance and reproducibility
criteria.requirement: A run can be reproduced and audited later, including analyzer version, command, configuration, toolchain, fingerprints, coverage, and limitations.
criteria.passEvidence: A run manifest is generated by the checked-in provenance tooling and identifies non-authoritative or partial runs.

criteria.title: Operational fit
criteria.requirement: The candidate can run in the intended service environment with an acceptable setup, licensing, isolation, and execution model.
criteria.passEvidence: The evaluation records runtime prerequisites, dependency distribution, process boundary, and a rough integration estimate.

criteria.title: Framework entrypoints
criteria.requirement: The candidate accounts for framework-owned entrypoints such as Spring MVC routes, Spring Boot lifecycle callbacks, @Bean methods, security filters, and Quarkus REST/CDI entrypoints.
criteria.passEvidence: The FrameworkModel emits a synthetic edge from explicit framework metadata, or the result is marked unknown with the missing model and coverage impact.

decisionRules.selectableStartingPoint: AC-01, AC-02, AC-07, and AC-08 pass; every failed or unverified required criterion has an explicit gap owner, abstention behavior, and closure estimate.
decisionRules.definiteRelationship: Only source, bytecode, framework metadata, or runtime evidence that uniquely identifies the edge may produce definite certainty.
decisionRules.possibleRelationship: A bounded candidate set may produce possible certainty when the evidence is incomplete but meaningful.
decisionRules.unresolvedRelationship: Open-world, dynamic, or missing-context behavior must remain unresolved/unknown and must not be silently dropped.

estimateAssumptions.assumes: One engineer familiar with Java, Maven, Quarkus, Spring Boot, and static analysis; existing fixture and contract tooling are reusable.
estimateAssumptions.excludes: Production graph engine, controller, endpoint mapping, runtime validation platform, Python support, and general sound resolution of arbitrary dynamic Java behavior.
